ca-sea-to-sky-highway.story: Repeated coastal bends, headlands and frequent viewpoint stops. It also links naturally to Howe Sound UNESCO Biosphere Reserve.
ca-sea-to-sky-highway.legalNote: Check provincial road reports, wildfire closures, ferries and fuel range. Specific flag: congestion; weather.

scenicChapters.title: Sea-to-Sky Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 50 km this is Sea-to-Sky Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
